title: Positive LIMIT inside a correlated EXISTS becomes unnecessary window work.

proposal_metadata.rationale: Strip only literal-positive offset-free limits at EXISTS consumer binding before dependent LIMIT can become row numbering. Apply to simple and generic filter consumers.
proposal_metadata.limits: Only directly exposed Limit chains; no movement across expression-evaluation wrappers, unknown/zero counts, offsets, IN or scalar consumers.
proposal_metadata.validation: Native plan counts for dependent row numbering plus EXISTS/NOT EXISTS semantic controls, zero/offset/parameter limits and IN/scalar preservation.

verification_limitation: Source preparation only; compilation, native semantics and optimization evidence still required.
